rca_of_issue: Iteration 13 bugs (both fixed): (A) Stripe Managed Payments (enabled by default on live account) required a product tax_code on the Checkout Session line_items. Fix: pack.py:101 now sets product_data.tax_code='txcd_10000000' (Services — general, applicable to the digital service invoice). (B) Order document was inserted BEFORE Stripe API call, leaving dangling pending rows without session_id when Stripe rejected the payload. Fix: pack.create_checkout now inserts the order AFTER stripe.checkout.Session.create() succeeds, so failures (e.g., 422 on invalid return_url, or any Stripe error) leave no order behind. Verified via (i) HTTP 201 + cs_live_ URL, (ii) HTTP 422 on {return_url:'foo'} without changing last_order.order_id, (iii) direct MongoDB count: 0 orders with missing session_id on the target property.
